items.title: Sheila Jordan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was in a booth and, uh, Denzil was... What he said to George? He said, 'She scares me.'

ctx.x: …and fired George. So, so, can we talk a little bit about this session? And if you could tell the, um, you know, for the historical record, something about Denzil Best „cause, you know, unfortunately, he‟s [inaudible].

Well, the one thing that we, we recorded this at, at, um, Rudy Van Gelder‟s. And Rudy was tough. You know, he was very careful. I remember we had a break, and uh, Swallow and I started going up the steps to go to the… we thought the bathroom was… “Where are you going?” He flipped out, you know. And we said, “Oh, well, we thought the bathroom was…” “No, it‟s not. It‟s down here.” [laughs] I said, “Oh, okay.” But I remembered that. But uh, I was in a booth and, uh, Denzil was… You know what Denzil said? [laughs]…
